source_limitations.judgment: Four identically rendered unordered random markers cannot identify their ordered target channels; no translation repair.
Docs/main/quiz use raw first differences; output skill uses sign offsets and a separate quadratic variant. All source surfaces remain distinct.
Main requires both axes interior; skill masks boundaries per axis. Clamping alone is not proof of zero difference.
Model lacks skip connections. Two stride-2 padded convolutions and two 2x transposed convolutions give 4*ceil(L/4); interpolation remains unchanged.
Complete bottom-up constant-time claim is preserved although candidate matching/grouping is described; not independently validated.
Universal heatmap/decoder claims, fixed latency, ranking/version claims, specific products and 500+ annotation minimum remain unverified.
Picker differs in YOLOv8-pose classification and groups MHFormer with temporal lifting rather than the body direct-regression grouping.
Five-question 2-pre/3-post package and absent lesson/title fields/header/tests differ from repository contract; outside translation scope.
Body two bare fences receive only text tags; all nine payloads exact. Other package fences are not altered.
Read provider registration and counted 12 joints/11 edges; unchanged marker is a generic illustration, not proof of COCO topology or rendered output.
Prerequisite Dice table contains unescaped absolute-value bars; no repair and no prerequisite Chinese acceptance assumption.
Four-channel synthetic demo has no person detection/PAF association/PCK/OKS/production schema implementation; decoder returns grid coordinates without inverse crop/stride transformation.
Docs use 8-pixel margins/new RNG, main uses 10-pixel margins/supplied seeded RNG. Protected snippets retain the difference.
OpenPose label 2017 and arXiv 1812.08008 retained; external bibliography not checked.

findings.issue: mAP 首次仅藏在 mAP@OKS 标记中，没有给出已批准的中文解释“平均精确率均值”。PCK、OKS、IoU 已解释，mAP 仍对读者不透明。
findings.requested_action: 在同一块首次出现处解释 mAP（平均精确率均值），保持 mAP@OKS 字符串和源文指标关系不变；不新增计算公式或修正源主张。

findings.issue: “The dominant top-down keypoint architecture”译为“主流的自顶向下关键点架构”，将占主导地位的判断弱化为属于主流。
findings.requested_action: 将“主流的”改为“占主导地位的”或同等强度的表述；保留后半句全程高分辨率特征，不自行验证或改写源排名。

limits.strict_gate: Not issued by this review; protected-surface static checks are not the original strict gate.

content.closure_required: Revise T01 and T02, freeze new target/record hashes, and independently review the actual changed blocks. This report continues to bind only its initial bytes; unchanged blocks may inherit it by exact hash.

content.summary: 正文可连续顺读，未发现妨碍理解的中文语序、指代或教学衔接错误。需按本阶段明确的首现规则补齐六个术语的英文对照；这是轻微术语规范问题，不是来源技术纠错。

reading.mode: One uninterrupted top-to-bottom reading of the complete frozen Chinese body, including all headings, prose, lists, table rows and fenced material as text. Source, support and record consultation began only after this reading.

independence.reviewer_role: Separate Chinese-language reader; not the author or bilingual reviewer.

coverage.coverage_method: Complete manual continuous reading, followed by a static stdlib-only record/line enumeration for report locations. This is not a parser, rendering or runtime acceptance claim.

findings.description: 本阶段 TERMINOLOGY.md 明确要求可译技术术语在正文首现时附原文英文或缩写。以下六个已列入本阶段术语表的名词目前只有中文；阅读含义基本清楚，但首现配对不完整。
findings.proposed_action: 只在上述首现处补英文对照，后文保持现有中文即可。世界坐标的后续出现不必重复展开。保留同句中的原有数字、范围、模型名及技术陈述。
findings.reason_not_source_repair: 这些补充只落实已批准的中英术语首现约定，不改变固定英文的技术主张，也不要求验证或运行课程。
findings.closure_check: 返回修订后的正文与记录哈希后，检查六处首现、所在段落的连续可读性和记录对应内容；确认其他正文未意外改动。
